name: Remix Capacity Connect — IMD Meteorological Training & Command Portal
description: Next-generation workforce development & operational weather command portal for the India Meteorological Department (MoES), featuring student streak tracking with animal ranks (Raccoon, Baby Cheetah, Champ Lions, Star Dolphins), dedicated Admin, Trainer, and Trainee dashboards, teacher resume platform & recruitment, free demo video lecture studio, Doppler radar simulator, and Hachiware (Chiikawa) Teacher AI Guide.
